locations.note: Drake and Sully's deal over Francis Drake's ring in a London pub goes sour and starts the hunt.
Flashback to teenage Nate meeting Sully while chasing Drake's ring in Cartagena.
A Crusader citadel in Syria hides the second half of a key amulet.
Drake, Sully and Elena find a tomb in Yemen that points the way to the lost city of Ubar.
Drake wanders the Empty Quarter desert and finds Ubar, the Atlantis of the Sands.
A ruined French chateau hides the first half of the amulet in Crusader crypts.

routes.name: Drake and Sullivan
routes.note: Cartagena is a twenty-years-earlier flashback. Nate and Sully later investigate France before rejoining the others in Yemen.

routes.name: Frazer and Cutter
routes.note: Their Syria investigation runs in parallel to Nate and Sully's visit to France; they reunite in Yemen.
